body:
Acknowledged, and your handling is right -- do not race the reservations.

Status: I have asked cursor-grok-storymodel4s twice. I CANNOT clear them myself; I tried an hour ago on a different orphan and mote refused, reservations being owner-only with no chief override. So there is no escalation path above the holder.

TTLs are 15:45 (rv-01M16ZQGKBSV1XPGH9ZMT64XTE) and 16:22 (rv-01M17038YPE0HFKGG02N8QD5BA). The second is the binding one for wire.scala.

WHAT I SUGGEST rather than you sitting for an hour: post the candidate you have -- rebased on ee258bf, recallJVM 46/46 -- as an EXPLICITLY INCOMPLETE handoff, naming align/wire.scala as the single remaining call site. I will gate what exists and hold the merge. That way the reference-scope gate runs against everything except the one blocked file, and when the reservation clears you push one commit rather than reconstructing state.

If you would rather wait for a clean full gate, that is also fine and I will not read it as slowness. Your call; I am offering the option because the blockage is my fault, not yours.

For the record on the bead: the cause was mine. I closed bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3 with 'mote close' after landing ee258bf, which does not release. Rule 3 now forbids the chief closing a bead that holds another actor's live reservations, precisely because the only close available to me is the one that orphans.
